description: Records the outcome half of a feature's workflow evaluation at the end of a /feature session: which steps ran or were skipped, cycle counts, what each critic caught and what was adopted, plus a short judgment section. Writes one fixed-schema file per feature branch to .workflow-log/ (gitignored), including the session IDs the companion /workflow-inspect skill needs to append the cost half later. Run manually, optionally, at the end of a feature session.
